patch_description: The earlier programs reward direct demand and selected two-hop paths. This design keeps those signals but treats relay choice as a small, normalized allocation: each OD pair distributes its route reward across only its strongest relays, with pressure-adjusted path plausibility. It also aggregates those allocations into a modest link-level exposure signal, so links useful to many plausible routes receive some credit without letting transit centrality overwhelm direct demand. A stronger degree penalty is intended to reduce invalid samples before repair.
